    .hero-bg{background-image:linear-gradient(to right,rgba(15,23,42,.95),rgba(15,23,42,.65)),url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1486406146926-c627a92ad1ab?q=80&w=2670&auto=format&fit=crop');background-size:cover;background-position:center}
    .table-container{scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#cbd5e1 transparent}
    .table-container::-webkit-scrollbar{height:8px}
    .table-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background-color:#cbd5e1;border-radius:4px}
    .score-bar{transition:width 1.2s ease-out}
    .timeline-container::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:12px;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);z-index:0}
    .mermaid{background:transparent!important}
    .nav-dot{cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s}
  </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 font-sans leading-relaxed selection:bg-indigo-600 selection:text-white">
<div id="app"></div>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('report-data').textContent);
  const meta = data.metadata;
  const s = data.sections;

  // ── Helpers ──
  const getRiskBadge = l => ({ 'High':'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200','Medium–High':'bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 border-orange-200','Medium':'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200','Low':'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200' }[l] || 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-slate-200');
  const getProbBadge = p => p==='High'?'bg-red-100 text-red-700 border-red-200':p==='Medium'?'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border-orange-200':'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-200';
  const getMatColor = n => n<=1?{dot:'bg-red-500',bar:'bg-red-500',text:'text-red-600'}:n<=2?{dot:'bg-orange-500',bar:'bg-orange-500',text:'text-orange-600'}:n<=3?{dot:'bg-amber-500',bar:'bg-amber-500',text:'text-amber-600'}:{dot:'bg-emerald-500',bar:'bg-emerald-500',text:'text-emerald-600'};
  const dot = n => { const c=getMatColor(n); return `<span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-8 h-8 rounded-full font-bold text-white text-xs ${c.dot}">${n}</span>`; };
  const secTitle = (num,title,sub='') => `<div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12" data-animate="fade-up"><div class="border-l-[6px] border-report-500 pl-8 py-2 mb-10"><p class="text-report-500 font-bold tracking-widest uppercase text-sm mb-3">${num}</p><h2 class="text-4xl md:text-5xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">${title}</h2>${sub?`<p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-2">${sub}</p>`:''}</div></div>`;
  const divider = () => `<div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12 border-t border-slate-200 pt-4"></div>`;

  // ── S01 HERO ──
  const renderHero = () => `
  <section class="h-[95vh] flex flex-col justify-end p-8 md:p-16 lg:p-24 hero-bg text-white relative overflow-hidden">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-900/90 via-slate-900/40 to-transparent"></div>
    <div class="relative z-10 max-w-5xl">
      <div class="mb-6 inline-flex items-center px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-indigo-400/50 bg-indigo-500/20 text-blue-100 text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase shadow-lg">${meta.documentId}</div>
      <h1 class="text-6xl md:text-8xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-4 text-white drop-shadow-sm">${meta.title}</h1>
      <h2 class="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-light text-slate-300 mb-12 max-w-3xl leading-snug">${meta.subtitle}</h2>
      <div class="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8 border-t border-white/20 pt-8 dark-glass rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-2xl items-center">
        <div><p class="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Company</p><p class="font-medium text-white">${meta.company}</p></div>
        <div><p class="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Function Group</p><p class="font-medium text-white">${meta.functionGroup}</p></div>
        <div><p class="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Issue Date</p><p class="font-medium text-white">${meta.date}</p></div>
        <div><p class="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Status</p><p class="font-medium text-indigo-300 flex items-center gap-2"><span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-400 animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(129,140,248,0.8)]"></span>${meta.status}</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>`;

  // ── S01 EXEC SUMMARY ──
  const renderExec = () => `
  ${secTitle('Section 01','Executive Summary','Strategic context and transformation imperative')}
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-8 md:col-start-3" data-animate="fade-up">
    <p class="text-slate-600 text-xl font-light leading-relaxed mb-6">${s.executiveSummary.context}</p>
    <p class="text-slate-600 text-xl font-light leading-relaxed">${s.executiveSummary.currentState}</p>
  </div>
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12" data-animate="fade-up">
    <div class="bg-[#0f172a] rounded-[2rem] p-8 md:p-10 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden border border-slate-800">
      <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 w-96 h-96 bg-indigo-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/3 pointer-events-none"></div>
      <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-6 flex items-center gap-3 relative z-10">
        <svg class="w-7 h-7 text-indigo-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z"/></svg>
        Core Structural Issues Identified
      </h3>
      <ul class="space-y-4 relative z-10">${s.executiveSummary.coreIssues.map(i=>`<li class="flex items-start gap-4 text-slate-300 text-lg font-light leading-relaxed"><span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(129,140,248,0.8)] mt-2.5 shrink-0"></span><p>${i}</p></li>`).join('')}</ul>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12" data-animate="fade-up">
    <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-6">Risk Exposure Overview</h3>
    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4" data-stagger>
      ${s.executiveSummary.riskImpact.map(r=>`<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow group relative overflow-hidden"><div class="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-200 group-hover:bg-report-500 transition-colors"></div><span class="text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${getRiskBadge(r.severity)} mb-3 inline-block">${r.severity}</span><p class="font-bold text-slate-800 mb-2">${r.category}</p><p class="text-xs text-slate-500 leading-relaxed">${r.exposure}</p></div>`).join('')}
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12" data-animate="zoom-in">
    <blockquote class="bg-slate-900 rounded-[2.5rem] p-10 md:p-14 text-white shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden transform md:scale-105 my-4">
      <div class="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-2.5 bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-400 to-emerald-500"></div>
      <p class="relative z-10 text-2xl font-light leading-relaxed">${s.executiveSummary.transformationOpportunity}</p>
    </blockquote>
  </div>
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12" data-animate="fade-up">
    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-4">Proposed Solution Stack</h3>
    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4" data-stagger>
      ${s.executiveSummary.solutions.map(sol=>`<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group relative overflow-hidden"><div class="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-200 group-hover:bg-report-500 transition-colors"></div><span class="inline-block text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full mb-3 ${sol.priority==='P0'?'bg-red-100 text-red-700 border border-red-200':sol.priority==='P1'?'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200':'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200'}">${sol.priority}</span><p class="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">${sol.code}</p><p class="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm leading-snug">${sol.name}</p></div>`).join('')}
    </div>
  </div>`;

  // ── S02 DIAGNOSTIC ──
  const renderDiagnostic = () => `
  ${secTitle('Section 02','Current State Diagnostic','Process landscape, system architecture, and governance assessment')}
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12" data-animate="fade-up">
    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-4">2.1 Process Landscape</h3>
    <div class="space-y-3">
      ${s.diagnostic.processLandscape.map(r=>`<div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-start gap-4 bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 hover:border-report-300 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all shadow-sm" data-animate="fade-up"><div class="w-full md:w-1/4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">${r.dimension}</div><div class="w-full md:w-1/4 text-sm font-semibold text-indigo-600">${r.current}</div><div class="w-full md:w-2/4 text-sm text-slate-500 leading-relaxed">${r.observation}</div></div>`).join('')}
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12" data-animate="fade-up">
    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-4 mt-4">2.2 System & Data Architecture</h3>
    <div class="space-y-3">
      ${s.diagnostic.systemArch.map(r=>`<div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-start gap-4 bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 hover:border-report-300 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all shadow-sm" data-animate="fade-up"><div class="w-full md:w-1/4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">${r.dimension}</div><div class="w-full md:w-1/4 text-sm font-semibold text-indigo-600">${r.current}</div><div class="w-full md:w-2/4 text-sm text-orange-600 leading-relaxed">${r.gap}</div></div>`).join('')}
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12" data-animate="fade-up">
    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-4 mt-4">2.3 Governance & Accountability</h3>
    <div class="space-y-3">
      ${s.diagnostic.governance.map(r=>`<div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-start gap-4 bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 hover:border-report-300 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all shadow-sm" data-animate="fade-up"><div class="w-full md:w-1/4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">${r.dimension}</div><div class="w-full md:w-1/4 text-sm font-semibold text-indigo-600">${r.current}</div><div class="w-full md:w-2/4 text-sm text-orange-600 leading-relaxed">${r.gap}</div></div>`).join('')}
    </div>
  </div>`;

  // ── S03 PAIN POINTS ──
  const renderPainPoints = () => `
  ${secTitle('Section 03','Pain Point Clusters','6 confirmed structural pain themes across NSI-FG-002')}
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8" data-stagger>
    ${s.painPoints.map(pp=>`<div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] p-8 shadow-lg shadow-slate-200/50 border border-slate-100 flex flex-col h-full group relative overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-2xl"><div class="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-200 group-hover:bg-report-500 transition-colors"></div><div class="flex items-start justify-between mb-4 mt-2"><span class="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-full">${pp.theme}</span><span class="text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full border ${getRiskBadge(pp.severity)}">${pp.severity}</span></div><h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-4 leading-snug">${pp.title}</h3><div class="space-y-3 flex-1"><div><p class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Evidence</p><p class="text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">${pp.evidence}</p></div><div><p class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Operational Impact</p><p class="text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">${pp.impact}</p></div><div><p class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Root Cause</p><p class="text-sm text-slate-500 italic leading-relaxed">${pp.rootCause}</p></div></div><div class="mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2"><p class="text-xs text-slate-400">${pp.frequency}</p><span class="text-xs font-mono bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg border border-indigo-100">${pp.kpis}</span></div></div>`).join('')}
  </div>`;

  // ── S04 ROOT CAUSE ──
  const rcCard = (item, color) => `<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow" data-animate="fade-up"><div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2"><span class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full ${color} text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">${item.id}</span><div><p class="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">${item.desc}</p><p class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">Themes: ${item.themes}</p></div></div><p class="text-xs text-slate-500 leading-relaxed mt-2 pl-11">${item.explanation}</p></div>`;
  const renderRootCause = () => `
  ${secTitle('Section 04','Root Cause Analysis','Structural, systemic, and behavioral root causes mapped to pain clusters')}
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
    <div data-animate="fade-up">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-5"><span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-red-500"></span><h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800">Structural (S1–S5)</h3></div>
      <div class="space-y-4">${s.rootCauses.structural.map(i=>rcCard(i,'bg-red-500')).join('')}</div>
    </div>
    <div data-animate="fade-up">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-5"><span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-orange-500"></span><h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800">Systemic (Y1–Y3)</h3></div>
      <div class="space-y-4">${s.rootCauses.systemic.map(i=>rcCard(i,'bg-orange-500')).join('')}</div>
    </div>
    <div data-animate="fade-up">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-5"><span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-amber-500"></span><h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800">Behavioral (B1–B2)</h3></div>
      <div class="space-y-4">${s.rootCauses.behavioral.map(i=>rcCard(i,'bg-amber-500')).join('')}</div>
    </div>
  </div>`;

  // ── S05 STRATEGIC IMPLICATIONS ──
  const renderStrategic = () => `
  ${secTitle('Section 05','Strategic Implications','Cross-dimensional risk and opportunity analysis')}
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6" data-stagger>
    ${s.strategicImplications.map(si=>`<div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] p-7 border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group relative overflow-hidden"><div class="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-200 group-hover:bg-report-500 transition-colors"></div><div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 mt-1"><p class="font-bold text-slate-800">${si.dimension}</p><span class="text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${getRiskBadge(si.severity)}">${si.severity}</span></div><p class="text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed mb-3">${si.implication}</p><p class="text-xs text-indigo-500 font-semibold">Horizon: ${si.horizon}</p></div>`).join('')}
  </div>`;

  // ── S06 MATURITY ──
  const renderMaturity = () => `
  ${secTitle('Section 06','Maturity Scorecard','Function group and solution domain maturity assessment')}
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-12">
    <div data-animate="fade-left">
      <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-6">FG-Level Maturity — Current vs Target</h3>
      <div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] p-8 border border-slate-200 shadow-lg"><canvas id="maturity-radar" height="320"></canvas></div>
      <div class="mt-6 text-center"><div class="inline-flex items-center gap-3 bg-orange-50 border border-orange-200 rounded-2xl px-6 py-4"><span class="text-3xl font-black text-orange-600">Level 2</span><span class="text-slate-500 font-medium">— Controlled but Fragmented</span></div></div>
    </div>
    <div data-animate="fade-up">
      <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-6">Dimension Detail</h3>
      <div class="space-y-4">${s.maturity.dimensions.map(d=>{const c=getMatColor(d.score),pct=(d.score/5)*100;return`<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border border-slate-100 shadow-sm"><div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2"><p class="font-semibold text-slate-800">${d.dimension}</p><span class="text-sm font-bold ${c.text}">${d.score}/5</span></div><div class="h-2 bg-slate-100 rounded-full mb-3 overflow-hidden"><div class="score-bar h-full rounded-full ${c.bar}" style="width:0" data-target-width="${pct}"></div></div><p class="text-xs text-slate-500 leading-relaxed">${d.explanation}</p></div>`;}).join('')}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12" data-animate="fade-up">
    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-6 mt-4">6.2 Maturity by Solution Domain</h3>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] shadow-lg border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden table-container overflow-x-auto">
      <table class="w-full text-left min-w-[700px]">
        <thead><tr class="bg-slate-900 text-white uppercase text-xs tracking-wider"><th class="p-4 font-semibold rounded-tl-[2rem]">Solution Domain</th><th class="p-4 font-semibold text-center">Process</th><th class="p-4 font-semibold text-center">System</th><th class="p-4 font-semibold text-center">Data</th><th class="p-4 font-semibold text-center">Governance</th><th class="p-4 font-semibold text-center">Scalability</th><th class="p-4 font-semibold text-center rounded-tr-[2rem]">Avg</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody class="text-slate-700 text-sm divide-y divide-slate-100">${s.maturity.bySolution.map(r=>{const avgC=getMatColor(Math.round(r.avg));return`<tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"><td class="p-4 font-semibold text-slate-800">${r.sol}</td>${[r.proc,r.sys,r.data,r.gov,r.scale].map(n=>`<td class="p-4 text-center">${dot(n)}</td>`).join('')}<td class="p-4 text-center"><span class="font-black text-lg ${avgC.text}">${r.avg.toFixed(1)}</span></td></tr>`;}).join('')}</tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-3">Color scale: 🔴 1=No capability, 🟠 2=Manual/basic, 🟡 3=Defined, 🟢 4=Managed, 🔵 5=Optimized</p>
  </div>`;

  // ── S07 TARGET OPERATING MODEL ──
  const renderTOM = () => `
  ${secTitle('Section 07','Target Operating Model','Future state across process, system, and governance dimensions')}
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12" data-animate="fade-up">
    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-4">7.1 Process Shift</h3>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] shadow-lg border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden table-container overflow-x-auto">
      <table class="w-full text-left min-w-[700px]">
        <thead><tr class="bg-slate-900 text-white uppercase text-xs tracking-wider"><th class="p-4 font-semibold rounded-tl-[2rem]">Domain</th><th class="p-4 font-semibold">From (Current)</th><th class="p-4 font-semibold rounded-tr-[2rem]">To (Target)</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody class="text-slate-700 text-sm divide-y divide-slate-100">${s.targetOperatingModel.processShift.map(r=>`<tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"><td class="p-4 font-bold text-slate-800 w-48">${r.domain}</td><td class="p-4 text-red-500">${r.from}</td><td class="p-4 text-emerald-600 font-medium">${r.to}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12" data-animate="fade-up">
    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-4 mt-4">7.2 System Architecture Shift</h3>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] shadow-lg border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden table-container overflow-x-auto">
      <table class="w-full text-left min-w-[700px]">
        <thead><tr class="bg-slate-900 text-white uppercase text-xs tracking-wider"><th class="p-4 font-semibold rounded-tl-[2rem]">Layer</th><th class="p-4 font-semibold">Current</th><th class="p-4 font-semibold rounded-tr-[2rem]">Target</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody class="text-slate-700 text-sm divide-y divide-slate-100">${s.targetOperatingModel.systemShift.map(r=>`<tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"><td class="p-4 font-bold text-slate-800 w-48">${r.layer}</td><td class="p-4 text-red-500">${r.current}</td><td class="p-4 text-emerald-600 font-medium">${r.target}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12" data-animate="fade-up">
    <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-4 mt-4">7.3 Governance Model Shift</h3>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] shadow-lg border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden table-container overflow-x-auto">
      <table class="w-full text-left min-w-[700px]">
        <thead><tr class="bg-slate-900 text-white uppercase text-xs tracking-wider"><th class="p-4 font-semibold rounded-tl-[2rem]">Dimension</th><th class="p-4 font-semibold">Current</th><th class="p-4 font-semibold rounded-tr-[2rem]">Target</th></tr></thead>

<body class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 font-sans leading-relaxed selection:bg-report-500 selection:text-white">

    <div id="app"></div>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('report-data').textContent);
            const app = document.getElementById('app');

            // Utilities
            const renderSectionTitle = (sectionNumber, titleText, subtitleText = '') => `
                <div class="flex items-stretch gap-4 mb-8">
                    <div class="w-1.5 bg-[#0f172a] rounded-full"></div>
                    <div class="py-1">
                        <p class="text-indigo-500 font-bold tracking-widest uppercase text-xs mb-1">${sectionNumber}</p>
                        <h2 class="text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">${titleText}</h2>
                        ${subtitleText ? `<p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-2">${subtitleText}</p>` : ''}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            const getMaturityColor = (score) => {
                const s = score.toLowerCase();
                if (s.includes('low') && !s.includes('medium')) return 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200';
                if (s.includes('low-medium')) return 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200';
                if (s.includes('medium')) return 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200';
                return 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200';
            };
            
            const getExposureColor = (exposure) => {
                if (exposure === 'High') return 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200';
                if (exposure === 'Medium') return 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200';
                return 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200';
            };
            
            // Generate HTML for Sections
            let validSectionIndex = 1;
            const sectionsHtml = data.sections.map((section) => {
                
                // Track section number for standard sections (skip if it's the executive/final)
                let secNumStr = '';
                if (!section.isExecutiveFraming) {
                    secNumStr = `Section ${String(validSectionIndex).padStart(2, '0')}`;
                    validSectionIndex++;
                }

                // Process SubSections
                const subSectionsHtml = section.subSections.map(sub => {
                    let contentHtml = '';
                    const props = sub.customProperties;

                    // 1. Text Block
                    if (sub.type === 'textBlock') {
                        contentHtml = `
                            <div class="space-y-10 text-xl font-light max-w-5xl">
                                <p class="text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">${props.text}</p>
                                <blockquote class="bg-slate-900 rounded-[2.5rem] p-10 text-white shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden transform md:scale-105 my-12">
                                    <div class="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-2.5 bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-400 to-report-500"></div>
                                    <p class="relative z-10 text-2xl font-light leading-relaxed">${props.takeaway}</p>
                                </blockquote>
                            </div>
                        `;
                    } 
                    // 2. Snapshot Metrics
                    else if (sub.type === 'snapshotMetrics') {
                        let currentPct = 0;
                        const gradientString = props.metrics.map(item => {
                            const pct = (item.count / props.total) * 100;
                            const str = `${item.color} ${currentPct}% ${currentPct + pct}%`;
                            currentPct += pct;
                            return str;
                        }).join(', ');

                        contentHtml = `
                            <div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] p-8 md:p-10 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-8 lg:gap-16 items-center w-full">
                                <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 relative">
                                    <div class="w-48 h-48 rounded-full shadow-inner border border-slate-100 flex-shrink-0 relative flex items-center justify-center" style="background: conic-gradient(${gradientString})">
                                        <div class="w-32 h-32 bg-white rounded-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center shadow-md">
                                            <p class="text-4xl font-black text-slate-800">${props.total}</p>
                                            <p class="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Total</p>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="flex-1 w-full flex flex-col justify-center space-y-5">
                                    ${props.metrics.map(m => {
                                        let impactBadge = 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200';
                                        if (m.impact.includes('Critical')) impactBadge = 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200';
                                        else if (m.impact.includes('Very High')) impactBadge = 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200';
                                        else if (m.impact.includes('High')) impactBadge = 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200';
                                        
                                        return `
                                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:border-indigo-200 transition-all">
                                            <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                                                <div class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full shrink-0 shadow-sm border border-white" style="background-color: ${m.color}"></div>
                                                <p class="font-bold text-slate-800 text-lg">${m.category}</p>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="flex items-center gap-6">
                                                <div class="text-right">
                                                    <p class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Impact</p>
                                                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold border shadow-sm ${impactBadge}">${m.impact}</span>
                                                </div>
                                                <div class="w-px h-10 bg-slate-100 hidden sm:block"></div>
                                                <div class="text-center min-w-[3.5rem]">
                                                    <p class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-0.5">Count</p>
                                                    <p class="text-3xl font-black drop-shadow-sm" style="color: ${m.color}">${m.count}</p>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    `}).join('')}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        `;
                    } 
                    // 3. Rules List
                    else if (sub.type === 'rulesList') {
                        contentHtml = `
                            <div class="bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-100 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-sm">
                                <h4 class="text-lg font-bold text-report-800 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 16h-1v-4h-1m1-4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>
                                    ${sub.title || 'Classification Rules'}
                                </h4>
                                <ul class="space-y-3 text-sm text-report-900 list-decimal pl-5">
                                    ${props.rules.map(item => `<li>${item}</li>`).join('')}
                                </ul>
                            </div>
                        `;
                    } 
                    // 4. Governance Registers
                    else if (sub.type === 'registers') {
                        contentHtml = `
                            <div class="space-y-12">
                                ${props.items.map((reg, rIndex) => `
                                    <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-lg border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden">
                                        <div class="p-8 border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-900 text-white relative overflow-hidden">
                                            <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 w-64 h-64 bg-indigo-500/20 rounded-full blur-3xl -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/3"></div>
                                            <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4 relative z-10">${rIndex + 1}. ${reg.title}</h3>
                                            <p class="text-slate-300 font-light leading-relaxed max-w-4xl relative z-10">${reg.interpretation}</p>
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="table-container overflow-x-auto">
                                            <table class="w-full text-left min-w-[800px] border-collapse">
                                                <thead>
                                                    <tr class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 uppercase text-[10px] tracking-wider border-b border-slate-200">
                                                        <th class="p-4 font-bold w-40">Code</th>
                                                        <th class="p-4 font-bold w-1/3">Procedure Name</th>
                                                        <th class="p-4 font-bold">Automation Relevance / Exposure</th>
                                                    </tr>
                                                </thead>
                                                <tbody class="text-slate-700 text-sm divide-y divide-slate-100">
                                                    ${reg.procedures.map(proc => `
                                                        <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition-colors">
                                                            <td class="p-4 font-mono font-medium text-slate-900">${proc.code}</td>
                                                            <td class="p-4 font-bold text-slate-800">${proc.name}</td>
                                                            <td class="p-4 text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">${proc.relevance}</td>
                                                        </tr>
                                                    `).join('')}
                                                </tbody>
                                            </table>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                `).join('')}
                            </div>
                        `;
                    } 
                    // 5. Coverage Analysis Grid
                    else if (sub.type === 'coverageAnalysis') {
                        contentHtml = `
                            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
                                ${props.items.map(analysis => `
                                    <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col h-full">
                                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">${analysis.layer}</h3>
                                        <div class="space-y-6 flex-grow">
                                            <div>
                                                <p class="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-600 uppercase tracking-widest mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                                                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>
                                                    Strengths
                                                </p>
                                                <ul class="text-slate-600 text-sm space-y-2 list-disc pl-4">
                                                    ${analysis.strengths.map(s => `<li>${s}</li>`).join('')}
                                                </ul>
                                            </div>
                                            <div>
                                                <p class="text-[10px] font-bold text-red-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                                                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 8v4m0 4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>
                                                    Gaps & Exposure
                                                </p>
                                                <ul class="text-slate-600 text-sm space-y-2 list-disc pl-4 marker:text-red-400">
                                                    ${analysis.gaps.map(g => `<li>${g}</li>`).join('')}
                                                </ul>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                `).join('')}
                            </div>
                        `;
                    } 
                    // 6. Maturity Table
                    else if (sub.type === 'maturityTable') {
                        contentHtml = `
                            <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden">
                                <table class="w-full text-left">
                                    <thead>
                                        <tr class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 uppercase text-[10px] tracking-wider border-b border-slate-200">
                                            <th class="p-5 font-bold">Domain</th>
                                            <th class="p-5 font-bold">Current Maturity</th>
                                            <th class="p-5 font-bold">Exposure Level</th>
                                            <th class="p-5 font-bold">Notes</th>
                                        </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody class="text-slate-800 text-sm divide-y divide-slate-100">
                                        ${props.items.map(m => `
                                            <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50">
                                                <td class="p-5 font-bold text-slate-700">${m.domain}</td>
                                                <td class="p-5">
                                                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border whitespace-nowrap ${getMaturityColor(m.score)}">${m.score}</span>
                                                </td>
                                                <td class="p-5">
                                                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border whitespace-nowrap ${getExposureColor(m.exposure)}">${m.exposure}</span>
                                                </td>
                                                <td class="p-5 text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">${m.notes}</td>
                                            </tr>
                                        `).join('')}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>
                            </div>
                        `;
                    } 
                    // 7. Executive Framing
                    else if (sub.type === 'executiveFraming') {
                        contentHtml = `
                            <div class="mb-16">
                                <p class="text-slate-300 text-lg md:text-xl font-light max-w-4xl leading-relaxed">
                                    ${props.summary}
                                </p>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <h4 class="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-8 border-b border-white/10 pb-4 inline-block">Strategic Recommendations</h4>
                                <ol class="space-y-6 max-w-4xl">
                                    ${props.recommendations.map((rec, i) => `
                                        <li class="flex items-start gap-5">
                                            <div class="flex-shrink-0 w-8 h-8 rounded-full border border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 flex items-center justify-center font-bold shadow-sm mt-0.5">
                                                ${i + 1}
                                            </div>
                                            <p class="text-slate-200 text-lg font-light leading-relaxed">${rec}</p>
                                        </li>
                                    `).join('')}
                                </ol>
                            </div>
                        `;
                    } 
                    // 8. Reference Map
                    else if (sub.type === 'referenceMap') {
                        contentHtml = `
                            <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden">
                                <table class="w-full text-left">
                                    <thead>
                                        <tr class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 uppercase text-[10px] tracking-wider border-b border-slate-200">
                                            <th class="p-5 font-bold">Object Type</th>
                                            <th class="p-5 font-bold">Source</th>
                                            <th class="p-5 font-bold w-64">Evidence Linkages / Codes</th>
                                            <th class="p-5 font-bold">Used By</th>
                                        </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody class="text-slate-800 text-sm divide-y divide-slate-100">
                                        ${props.items.map(ref => `
                                            <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50">
                                                <td class="p-5 font-bold text-slate-700">${ref.type}</td>
                                                <td class="p-5 text-slate-600">${ref.source}</td>
                                                <td class="p-5 font-mono text-xs text-indigo-600 leading-relaxed">${ref.codes}</td>
                                                <td class="p-5 text-slate-500 text-xs">${ref.usedBy}</td>
                                            </tr>
                                        `).join('')}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>
                            </div>
                        `;
                    }

                    // Render SubSection block (Title + Content)
                    return `
                        <div class="mb-12 last:mb-0">
                            ${sub.title && sub.type !== 'rulesList' ? `<h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 mb-6">${sub.title}</h3>` : ''}
                            ${contentHtml}
                        </div>
                    `;
                }).join('');

                // Render parent Section Wrapper
                if (section.isExecutiveFraming) {
                    return `
                        <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12 mt-24 border-t border-slate-200 pt-16 mb-12">
                            <div class="bg-report-roadmapBg rounded-[3rem] p-12 md:p-16 text-white shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden">
                                <div class="mb-16">
                                    <p class="text-indigo-400 font-bold tracking-widest uppercase text-[10px] mb-4">FINAL SECTION</p>
                                    <h2 class="text-4xl md:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight mb-8">${section.title}</h2>
                                </div>
                                ${subSectionsHtml}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                return `
                    <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12 mt-12 border-t border-slate-200 pt-16">
                        ${renderSectionTitle(secNumStr, section.title, section.subtitle)}
                        <div class="pl-0 md:pl-8 lg:pl-16">
                            ${subSectionsHtml}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');

            const html = `
                <!-- COVER COMPONENT -->
                <section class="h-[95vh] flex flex-col justify-end p-8 md:p-16 lg:p-24 hero-bg text-white relative">
                    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-900/90 via-slate-900/40 to-transparent mix-blend-multiply"></div>
                    <div class="relative z-10 max-w-5xl">
                        <div class="mb-6 inline-flex items-center px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-report-500/50 bg-report-500/20 text-indigo-100 text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase shadow-lg">
                            ${data.metadata.documentId}
                        </div>
                        <h1 class="text-6xl md:text-8xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-4 text-white drop-shadow-sm">
                            ${data.metadata.title} <br/> <span class="text-report-500">${data.metadata.titleSuffix}</span>
                        </h1>
                        <h2 class="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-light text-slate-300 mb-12 max-w-3xl leading-snug">
                            ${data.metadata.subtitle}
                        </h2>

                        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8 border-t border-white/20 pt-8 mt-12 dark-glass rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl items-center">
                            ${data.metadata.coverDetails.map(detail => `
                                <div>
                                    <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">${detail.label}</p>
                                    <p class="font-medium text-white text-lg ${detail.isStatus ? 'text-report-500 flex items-center gap-2' : ''}">
                                        ${detail.isStatus ? '<span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-report-500 animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(99,102,241,0.8)]"></span>' : ''}
                                        ${detail.value}
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                            `).join('')}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </section>

                <main class="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-6 md:px-12 py-24 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-y-20 gap-x-8">
                    ${sectionsHtml}
                </main>
            `;
            
            app.innerHTML = html;
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<body class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 font-sans leading-relaxed selection:bg-report-500 selection:text-white">

            const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('report-data').textContent);

            `;

            // Generic styling helpers based on textual matching
            const getRelevanceBadge = (relevance) => {
                if (!relevance) return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-300';
                const normalized = relevance.toLowerCase();
                if(normalized.includes('core')) return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 border-purple-200';
                if(normalized.includes('critical')) return 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200';
                if(normalized.includes('high')) return 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200';
                if(normalized.includes('moderate')) return 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200';
                return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-300';
            };

            const getMaturityBadge = (score) => {

                  { "object": "Visibility Evidence", "codes": "PLC/SCADA estate references", "source": "List Of PLC; SCADA; Findings; File Used", "usedBy": "Appendix J Section 4", "notes": "Real-time visibility anchored to mixed PLC–SCADA linkage and 'no alarm log'." },
                  { "object": "Digital Leverage", "codes": "INA-SOL-01, INA-SOL-08, INA-SOL-17, INA-SOL-18", "source": "List Of Related Solution Proposed", "usedBy": "Appendix J Section 5", "notes": "Capability alignment only; no implementation claims." }

<body class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 font-sans leading-relaxed selection:bg-report-500 selection:text-white">

    <div id="app"></div>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('report-data').textContent);
            const app = document.getElementById('app');

            // --- HELPER FUNCTIONS ---
            const renderSectionTitle = (sectionNumber, titleText, subtitleText = '') => `
                <div class="flex items-stretch gap-4 mb-8">
                    <div class="w-1.5 bg-report-500 rounded-full"></div>
                    <div class="py-1">
                        <p class="text-report-500 font-bold tracking-widest uppercase text-xs mb-1">${sectionNumber}</p>
                        <h2 class="text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">${titleText}</h2>
                        ${subtitleText ? `<p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-2">${subtitleText}</p>` : ''}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            const getPriorityBadge = (priority) => {
                const map = {
                    'High': 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200',
                    'Med': 'bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 border-yellow-200',
                    'Low': 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200'
                };
                return map[priority] || 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200';
            };

            const getGranularityBadge = (granularity) => {
                const map = {
                    'Daily': 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200',
                    'Shift': 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200',
                    'Weekly': 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200',
                    'Monthly': 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200'
                };
                return map[granularity] || 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200';
            };

            const getStatusBadge = (status) => {
                if(status.toLowerCase().includes('not evidenced') || status.toLowerCase().includes('fragmented')) return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800';
                if(status.toLowerCase().includes('defined')) return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800';
                if(status.toLowerCase().includes('partial')) return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
                return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';
            };

            const getCategoryIcon = (title) => {
                if(title.includes('Production') || title.includes('Throughput')) return '<svg class="w-8 h-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 11H5m14 0a2 2 0 012 2v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-6a2 2 0 012-2m14 0V9a2 2 0 00-2-2M5 11V9a2 2 0 012-2m0 0V5a2 2 0 012-2h6a2 2 0 012 2v2M7 7h10"></path></svg>';
                if(title.includes('Maintenance') || title.includes('Reliability')) return '<svg class="w-8 h-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M10.325 4.317c.426-1.756 2.924-1.756 3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 002.573 1.066c1.543-.94 3.31.826 2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 001.065 2.572c1.756.426 1.756 2.924 0 3.35a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.066 2.573c.94 1.543-.826 3.31-2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.572 1.065c-.426 1.756-2.924 1.756-3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.573-1.066c-1.543.94-3.31-.826-2.37-2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.065-2.572c-1.756-.426-1.756-2.924 0-3.35a1.724 1.724 0 001.066-2.573c-.94-1.543.826-3.31 2.37-2.37.996.608 2.296.07 2.572-1.065z"></path><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"></path></svg>';
                if(title.includes('Quality') || title.includes('Compliance')) return '<svg class="w-8 h-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z"></path></svg>';
                if(title.includes('Inventory') || title.includes('Logistics')) return '<svg class="w-8 h-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 7h12m0 0l-4-4m4 4l-4 4m0 6H4m0 0l4 4m-4-4l4-4"></path></svg>';
                if(title.includes('Energy') || title.includes('Utilities')) return '<svg class="w-8 h-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 10V3L4 14h7v7l9-11h-7z"></path></svg>';
                return '<svg class="w-8 h-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 19v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2zm0 0V9a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v10m-6 0a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2m0 0V5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v14a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2z"></path></svg>';
            };

            const getImpactBadge = (impact) => {
                if (impact === 'Very High') return '<span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 border border-orange-200">Very High</span>';
                if (impact === 'Critical') return '<span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-200">Critical</span>';
                if (impact === 'High') return '<span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 border border-indigo-200">High</span>';
                return '<span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200">Medium</span>';
            };


            // --- COMPONENT RENDERERS ---

            const renderNarrative = (props) => `
                <div class="max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-10 text-xl font-light">
                    <p class="text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">${props.text}</p>
                    <blockquote class="bg-slate-900 rounded-[2.5rem] p-10 text-white shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden transform md:scale-105 my-12">
                        <div class="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-2.5 bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-400 to-report-500"></div>
                        <p class="relative z-10 text-2xl font-light leading-relaxed">${props.takeaway}</p>
                    </blockquote>
                </div>
            `;

            const renderDonutChart = (props) => {
                let currentPct = 0;
                const gradientString = props.data.map(item => {
                    const pct = (item.value / props.total) * 100;
                    const str = `${item.color} ${currentPct}% ${currentPct + pct}%`;
                    currentPct += pct;
                    return str;
                }).join(', ');

                return `
                    <div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-center gap-12 w-full mb-12 p-8 lg:p-10 bg-white border border-slate-100 rounded-[2rem] shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]">
                        <div class="w-64 h-64 rounded-full flex-shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center relative" style="background: conic-gradient(${gradientString})">
                            <div class="w-44 h-44 bg-white rounded-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative z-10 shadow-sm">
                                <span class="text-5xl font-black text-slate-800 tracking-tight">${props.total}</span>
                                <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest mt-1">Total</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex-grow w-full space-y-4">
                            ${props.data.map((item) => `
                                <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-4 md:p-5 border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors shadow-sm bg-white">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                                        <div class="w-4 h-4 rounded-full shrink-0" style="background-color: ${item.color}"></div>
                                        <h4 class="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800">${item.label}</h4>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-6 md:gap-10">
                                        <div class="flex flex-col items-end gap-1 hidden sm:flex">
                                            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Impact</span>
                                            ${getImpactBadge(item.impact)}
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="w-px h-10 bg-slate-100 hidden sm:block"></div>
                                        <div class="flex flex-col items-center min-w-[3rem] gap-0.5">
                                            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Count</span>
                                            <span class="text-3xl font-black leading-none" style="color: ${item.color}">${item.value}</span>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            `).join('')}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            };

            const renderKpiCategoryList = (props) => `
                <div class="space-y-12">
                    ${props.categories.map(cat => `
                        <div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] shadow-xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden mb-8 group transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-2xl">
                            <div class="bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-white border-b border-slate-200 p-8 relative overflow-hidden">
                                <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 w-64 h-64 bg-indigo-50 rounded-full blur-3xl -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/2 opacity-50 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500"></div>
                                
                                <div class="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-start gap-6">
                                    <div class="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm text-report-500 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 group-hover:bg-report-500 group-hover:text-white group-hover:border-report-600 transition-all duration-300">
                                        ${getCategoryIcon(cat.title)}
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="flex-grow">
                                        <div class="flex items-center gap-4 mb-3">
                                            <h3 class="text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-800">${cat.title}</h3>
                                            <span class="bg-report-100 text-report-700 border border-report-200 font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs shadow-sm">${cat.kpis.length} KPIs</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <p class="text-sm text-slate-600 font-medium leading-relaxed max-w-4xl">${cat.interpretation}</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="table-container overflow-x-auto">
                                <table class="w-full text-left min-w-[1000px] border-collapse">
                                    <thead>
                                        <tr class="bg-slate-50/80 backdrop-blur-sm text-slate-500 uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest border-b border-slate-200">
                                            <th class="p-4 pl-8 font-bold">Code</th>
                                            <th class="p-4 font-bold w-1/4">Name</th>
                                            <th class="p-4 font-bold text-center">Priority</th>
                                            <th class="p-4 font-bold text-center">Cadence</th>
                                            <th class="p-4 pr-8 font-bold w-1/2">Definition</th>
                                        </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody class="text-slate-700 text-sm divide-y divide-slate-100">
                                        ${cat.kpis.map(kpi => `
                                            <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors relative">
                                                <td class="p-5 pl-8 font-mono font-medium text-slate-500 text-xs">${kpi.code}</td>
                                                <td class="p-5 font-bold text-slate-800 text-base">${kpi.name}</td>
                                                <td class="p-5 text-center">
                                                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border uppercase tracking-widest ${getPriorityBadge(kpi.priority)}">${kpi.priority}</span>
                                                </td>
                                                <td class="p-5 text-center">
                                                    <span class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold border ${getGranularityBadge(kpi.granularity)}">${kpi.granularity}</span>
                                                </td>
                                                <td class="p-5 pr-8 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-600">${kpi.definition}</td>
                                            </tr>
                                        `).join('')}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `).join('')}
                </div>
            `;

            const renderGapLensGrid = (props) => `
                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                    ${props.items.map(gap => `
                        <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg transition-shadow flex flex-col h-full relative overflow-hidden group">
                            <div class="absolute top-0 left-0 w-1.5 h-full bg-slate-200 group-hover:bg-orange-400 transition-colors"></div>
                            <p class="text-lg font-medium text-slate-800 mb-6 leading-relaxed flex-grow pr-4">${gap.gap}</p>
                            
                            <div class="space-y-4 border-t border-slate-100 pt-6">
                                <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
                                    <span class="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400">Related Nodes/KPIs</span>
                                    <span class="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-report-500">${gap.kpis}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
                                    <span class="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400">Status</span>
                                    <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold uppercase ${getStatusBadge(gap.status)}">${gap.status}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `).join('')}
                </div>
            `;

            const renderMaturityTable = (props) => `
                <div class="bg-[#0f172a] rounded-[3rem] p-8 md:p-12 shadow-2xl border border-slate-800 relative overflow-hidden">
                    <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 w-96 h-96 bg-indigo-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/3 pointer-events-none"></div>
                    
                    <table class="w-full text-left relative z-10 hidden md:table">
                        <thead>
                            <tr class="text-slate-400 uppercase text-xs tracking-widest border-b border-slate-800">
                                <th class="p-4 pb-6 font-bold w-1/4">Dimension</th>
                                <th class="p-4 pb-6 font-bold w-1/6">Status</th>
                                <th class="p-4 pb-6 font-bold">Commentary & Anchor</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody class="text-slate-300 text-sm divide-y divide-slate-800/60">
                            ${props.rows.map(row => `
                                <tr class="hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition-colors">
                                    <td class="p-4 py-6 font-bold text-white text-base">${row.dimension}</td>
                                    <td class="p-4 py-6">
                                        <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded text-xs font-bold border border-transparent ${getStatusBadge(row.status)}">${row.status}</span>
                                    </td>
                                    <td class="p-4 py-6">
                                        <p class="leading-relaxed mb-2">${row.commentary}</p>
                                        <p class="text-[10px] font-mono text-indigo-300 uppercase tracking-widest bg-indigo-900/30 inline-block px-2 py-1 rounded border border-indigo-500/30">Evidence: ${row.anchor}</p>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            `).join('')}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>

                    <!-- Mobile view for maturity assessment -->
                    <div class="md:hidden space-y-6 relative z-10">
                         ${props.rows.map(row => `
                            <div class="bg-slate-800/50 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700">
                                <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                                    <h4 class="font-bold text-white text-lg">${row.dimension}</h4>
                                    <span class="px-2 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-bold uppercase ${getStatusBadge(row.status)}">${row.status}</span>
                                </div>
                                <p class="text-slate-300 text-sm leading-relaxed mb-3">${row.commentary}</p>
                                <p class="text-[10px] font-mono text-indigo-300 uppercase tracking-widest">Evidence: ${row.anchor}</p>
                            </div>
                        `).join('')}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            const renderImplicationsBlock = (props) => `
                <div class="space-y-8">
                    <div class="bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
                        <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4">${props.prioritiesTitle}</h4>
                        <p class="text-slate-800 font-medium text-lg leading-relaxed">${props.prioritiesText}</p>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bg-red-50 p-8 rounded-3xl border border-red-100 shadow-sm">
                        <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-red-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                            <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z"></path></svg>
                            ${props.breakdownsTitle}
                        </h4>
                        <ul class="space-y-4">
                            ${props.breakdownsList.map(b => `
                                <li class="flex items-start gap-3 text-red-900 text-sm font-medium">
                                    <span class="mt-1.5 w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-400 shrink-0"></span>
                                    ${b.replace(/->/g, '<span class="text-red-400 mx-1">→</span>')}
                                </li>
                            `).join('')}
                        </ul>
                    </div>

                    <div class="bg-indigo-50 rounded-3xl p-8 border border-indigo-100 shadow-sm">
                        <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-6">${props.leverageTitle}</h4>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                            ${props.leverageList.map(lev => `
                                <div class="bg-white p-5 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-indigo-50 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
                                    <p class="font-bold text-indigo-900 text-sm mb-2">${lev.solution}</p>
                                    <p class="text-slate-600 text-sm leading-relaxed">${lev.alignment}</p>
                                </div>
                            `).join('')}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            const renderReferenceTable = (props) => `
                <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">

<body class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 selection:bg-brand-primary selection:text-white pb-24">

    <!-- App Container -->

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

            // --- CAROUSEL LOGIC ---
            window.currentModuleIndex = 0;

                const mod = secs.modules.subsections.moduleList.items[currentModuleIndex];
                const content = `

                            </div>

                                    `).join('')}

                            </div>

                            <div class="p-6 pt-0 border-t border-slate-200">
                                <div class="table-wrapper mt-6 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
                                    <table class="w-full text-left min-w-[700px]">

                                        </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </details>
                    </div>
                </section>

                <!-- FOOTER -->
                <footer class="bg-brand-dark text-slate-400 py-12 text-center text-sm border-t border-white/10">
                    <p>© 2026 Machine Vision Indoensia. ${meta.classification}</p>
                </footer>
            `;
            
            app.innerHTML = html;
            window.renderCarouselSlide(); // Init Carousel
        });
    </script>
</body>
