                                        <tr class="transition-colors hover:bg-slate-50/50">
                                            <td class="py-6 px-8 font-black text-3xl text-slate-900 text-center">${s.score}</td>
                                            <td class="py-6 px-8 font-bold text-slate-800 text-lg">${s.level}</td>
                                            <td class="py-6 px-8 text-slate-500 text-base">${s.def}</td>
                                        </tr>
                                    `).join('')}
                                </tbody>
                            </table>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div class="bg-[#f4f7ff] border border-indigo-100 rounded-[1.5rem] p-8 md:p-10">
                            <p class="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4">${data.sections.s3_scoringScale.methodologyTitle}</p>
                            <ul class="space-y-3 text-sm text-indigo-900/80 list-disc pl-5 marker:text-indigo-500">
                                ${data.sections.s3_scoringScale.methodology.map(m => `<li>${m}</li>`).join('')}
                            </ul>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- SECTION 4 -->
                    <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12 mt-12 border-t border-slate-200 pt-16">
                        ${renderSectionTitle('Section 04', data.sections.s4_parameterDictionary.title, data.sections.s4_parameterDictionary.subtitle)}
                        
                        <div class="space-y-16">
                            ${data.sections.s4_parameterDictionary.dimensions.map(dict => `
                                <div class="bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-lg rounded-[2.5rem] overflow-hidden">
                                    <!-- Header -->
                                    <div class="bg-slate-900 text-white p-8 md:p-10 relative overflow-hidden">
                                        <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 w-64 h-64 bg-indigo-500/20 rounded-full blur-3xl -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/3"></div>
                                        <div class="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                                            <div>
                                                <span class="inline-block px-3 py-1 bg-white/10 border border-white/20 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold tracking-widest uppercase mb-3 text-indigo-200">${dict.id}</span>
                                                <h3 class="text-3xl font-bold">${dict.title}</h3>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 max-w-sm pl-4 border-l border-slate-700 hidden md:block">
                                                <ul class="list-disc pl-4 space-y-1">
                                                    ${dict.scope.slice(0, 3).map(s => `<li>${s}</li>`).join('')}
                                                    ${dict.scope.length > 3 ? `<li>...</li>` : ''}
                                                </ul>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    
                                    <!-- Body -->
                                    <div class="p-8 md:p-10 bg-slate-50">
                                        
                                        <div class="mb-10">
                                            <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4">Parameter Table</h4>
                                            <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 overflow-x-auto">
                                                <table class="w-full text-left min-w-[800px]">
                                                    <thead>
                                                        <tr class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 uppercase text-xs tracking-wider border-b border-slate-200">
                                                            <th class="p-4 font-bold">ID</th>
                                                            <th class="p-4 font-bold">Parameter</th>
                                                            <th class="p-4 font-bold">Description</th>
                                                            <th class="p-4 font-bold">Anchor</th>
                                                        </tr>
                                                    </thead>
                                                    <tbody class="text-sm divide-y divide-slate-100">
                                                        ${dict.parameters.map(p => `
                                                            <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50">
                                                                <td class="p-4 font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 whitespace-nowrap">${p.id}</td>
                                                                <td class="p-4 font-semibold text-slate-800">${p.name}</td>
                                                                <td class="p-4 text-slate-600">${p.desc}</td>
                                                                <td class="p-4"><span class="px-2 py-1 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 whitespace-nowrap">${p.anchor}</span></td>
                                                            </tr>
                                                        `).join('')}
                                                    </tbody>
                                                </table>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>

                                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
                                            <div class="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
                                                <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4">Scoring Triggers</h4>
                                                <ul class="space-y-3 text-sm text-slate-700">
                                                    ${dict.criteria.map(c => {
                                                        const parts = c.split(': ');
                                                        return `
                                                        <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
                                                            <div class="shrink-0 mt-0.5"><span class="w-6 h-6 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold border border-slate-200">${parts[0].replace('Score ', '')}</span></div>
                                                            <p>${parts[1]}</p>
                                                        </li>`;
                                                    }).join('')}
                                                </ul>
                                            </div>
                                            
                                            <div class="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
                                                <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4">Evidence Context</h4>
                                                <ul class="space-y-3 text-sm text-slate-700 list-disc pl-5">
                                                    ${dict.context.map(c => `<li>${c}</li>`).join('')}
                                                </ul>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            `).join('')}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- SECTION 5 -->
                    <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12 mt-12 border-t border-slate-200 pt-16">
                        ${renderSectionTitle('Section 05', data.sections.s5_weightingLogic.title, data.sections.s5_weightingLogic.subtitle)}
                        
                        <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 p-8 md:p-12">
                            <p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-8 max-w-3xl">${data.sections.s5_weightingLogic.rules}</p>
                            
                            <div class="space-y-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto">
                                ${data.sections.s5_weightingLogic.data.map(w => `
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                                        <div class="w-16 text-right font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">${w.code}</div>
                                        <div class="w-48 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 truncate">${w.name}</div>
                                        <div class="flex-grow flex items-center gap-3">
                                            <div class="bg-slate-100 rounded-r-lg h-6 flex overflow-hidden w-full max-w-[500px]">
                                                <div class="bg-indigo-500 h-full transition-all" style="width: ${(w.weight / 15) * 100}%"></div>
                                            </div>
                                            <span class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 w-8">${w.weight}%</span>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                `).join('')}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- SECTION 6 -->
                    <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12 mt-12 border-t border-slate-200 pt-16">
                        ${renderSectionTitle('Section 06', data.sections.s6_riskMapping.title, data.sections.s6_riskMapping.subtitle)}
                        
                        <div class="bg-white rounded-[1.5rem] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-8">
                            <table class="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                                <thead>
                                    <tr class="border-b border-slate-200">
                                        <th class="py-6 px-8 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest w-48">Score Range</th>
                                        <th class="py-6 px-8 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest w-64">Risk Level</th>
                                        <th class="py-6 px-8 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest">Indicator Map</th>
                                    </tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                                    ${data.sections.s6_riskMapping.ranges.map(r => `
                                        <tr class="transition-colors hover:bg-slate-50/50">
                                            <td class="py-6 px-8 font-mono text-xl text-slate-900 font-semibold">${r.range}</td>
                                            <td class="py-6 px-8">
                                                <span class="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border font-bold text-sm shadow-sm inline-block ${getRiskColorClass(r.color)}">
                                                    ${r.level}
                                                </span>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="py-6 px-8">
                                                <div class="w-full bg-slate-100 h-2.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden max-w-xs">
                                                    <div class="h-full ${r.color === 'red' ? 'bg-red-500' : r.color === 'orange' ? 'bg-orange-500' : r.color === 'blue' ? 'bg-blue-500' : 'bg-emerald-500'}" style="width: ${
                                                        r.level === 'High Risk' ? '25%' :
                                                        r.level === 'Moderate Risk' ? '50%' :
                                                        r.level === 'Controlled' ? '75%' : '100%'
                                                    }"></div>
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    `).join('')}
                                </tbody>
                            </table>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- SECTION 7 & 8 -->
                    <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-12 mt-12 border-t border-slate-200 pt-16 mb-24">
                        
                        <!-- Interpretation Rules -->
                        <div class="w-full">
                            ${renderSectionTitle('Section 07', data.sections.s7_executiveInterpretation.title)}
                            <div class="bg-indigo-50 rounded-3xl p-8 border border-indigo-100 shadow-sm">
                                <ul class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 text-sm text-indigo-900 font-medium">
                                    ${data.sections.s7_executiveInterpretation.rules.map(rule => `
                                        <li class="flex items-start gap-3 bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 shadow-sm h-full">
                                            <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>
                                            <p class="leading-relaxed">${rule}</p>
                                        </li>
                                    `).join('')}
                                </ul>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Reference Map -->
                        <div class="w-full">
                            ${renderSectionTitle('Section 08', data.sections.s8_referenceMap.title)}
                            <div class="bg-[#0f172a] rounded-[2.5rem] p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-slate-800">
                                <div class="overflow-x-auto">
                                    <table class="w-full text-left min-w-[600px]">
                                        <thead>
                                            <tr class="text-slate-400 uppercase text-[10px] tracking-wider border-b border-slate-800">
                                                <th class="p-4 pb-4 font-bold">Object Type</th>
                                                <th class="p-4 pb-4 font-bold">Code(s) / Outputs</th>
                                                <th class="p-4 pb-4 font-bold">Source / Used By</th>
                                                <th class="p-4 pb-4 font-bold">Notes</th>
                                            </tr>
                                        </thead>
                                        <tbody class="text-slate-300 text-sm divide-y divide-slate-800/60">
                                            ${data.sections.s8_referenceMap.mappings.map(ref => `
                                                <tr class="hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition-colors">
                                                    <td class="p-4 py-5 font-bold text-white whitespace-nowrap">${ref.type}</td>
                                                    <td class="p-4 py-5 font-mono text-xs text-indigo-300">${ref.code}</td>
                                                    <td class="p-4 py-5 text-xs text-slate-400"><span class="bg-slate-800 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-slate-700">${ref.source}</span> → ${ref.usedBy}</td>
                                                    <td class="p-4 py-5 text-xs text-slate-400">${ref.notes}</td>
                                                </tr>
                                            `).join('')}
                                        </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                    </div>
                </main>
            `;
            
            app.innerHTML = html;
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
